extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / new editors attempting to create or find an article on this topic
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for users trying to create or locate a Wikipedia article (here, 'Comedy xenophobia'): explains account requirements, checks to avoid duplication, and troubleshooting when a title is missing or deleted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles / alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Comedy xenophobia" in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the search to check for alternative titles or spellings before creating a new page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding inbound links can show whether the topic is already covered elsewhere or under a different title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recently created page visibility delay
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait a few minutes or try the purge function.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title capitalization and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check alternative capitalizations and consider creating a redirect to the canonical title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deleted page / check deletion log
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the deletion log to determine whether and why the title was removed before attempting to recreate it.
